import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

WORKSPACE_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

_CMD = [
    sys.executable,
    str(WORKSPACE_ROOT / "generated" / "agent.py"),
    "--input",
    str(WORKSPACE_ROOT / "uploads" / "input.csv"),
    "--contract",
    str(WORKSPACE_ROOT / "generated" / "author_output_contract.json"),
    "--row-output",
    str(WORKSPACE_ROOT / "outputs" / "output.csv"),
    "--report-path",
    str(WORKSPACE_ROOT / "reports" / "validation_report.md"),
]


def test_agent_runs():
    result = subprocess.run(_CMD, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=WORKSPACE_ROOT)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    assert (WORKSPACE_ROOT / "outputs" / "output.csv").exists()


def test_output_exists():
    assert (WORKSPACE_ROOT / "outputs" / "output.csv").exists()


def test_report_exists():
    assert (WORKSPACE_ROOT / "reports" / "validation_report.md").exists()
